name: Dr. Syed Mozaffar
bio: Dr. Syed Mozaffar is the founder and lead physiotherapist at The Muscular Junction and a neuro rehabilitation specialist. He combines individual assessment, personalised exercise, manual therapy and patient education to support movement, independence and everyday function.

education.institution: Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University, Islamabad

experience.institution: Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS), Islamabad

approach.title: Individual assessment
approach.text: Understanding your symptoms, movement, medical history and the activities that matter to you.

approach.title: Personalised rehabilitation
approach.text: Shaping exercise programmes and hands-on treatment around your needs, abilities and goals.

approach.title: Patient education
approach.text: Explaining your rehabilitation plan and helping you take an active role in your recovery.

approach.title: Shared goals and progress reviews
approach.text: Working with you to set meaningful goals and adapt care as your needs change.

profile.development: Dr. Mozaffar continues to develop his clinical knowledge through professional learning and participation in workshops. His clinical leadership at The Muscular Junction includes the following techniques:

name: Dr. Abdul Wahab
bio: Dr. Abdul Wahab works with children and adults, using play-based sessions to help them reach their motor milestones — and coaching parents so the progress continues at home between visits.

name: Dr. M. Abdullah
bio: Dr. M. Abdullah supports children through developmental and neurological rehabilitation programmes, designing sessions that hold a child's attention while still delivering the repetition recovery depends on.

name: Dr. Ulfat Zahra
bio: Dr. Ulfat Zahra, leads care for female patients who prefer a female therapist, working across musculoskeletal and post-operative rehabilitation to help patients regain mobility, balance and independence after injury or surgery.
